title: Aurora Solitaire
description: Build alternating card runs, draw from the stock and move each suit to its foundation in this streamlined browser solitaire game.
instructions: Select an exposed card, then choose a legal tableau lane or foundation. Draw from the stock when you need another card.

title: Neon Snake
description: Guide a glowing snake through a compact arena, collect energy and survive as the trail grows longer.
instructions: Use arrow keys, WASD or swipe controls to turn. Collect energy without hitting the wall or your own trail.

title: Pulse Jumper
description: Time one-button jumps through a neon obstacle course where speed and hazard spacing change as your run continues.
instructions: Tap, click or press Space to jump over hazards and keep the run alive.

title: Zen Sudoku
description: Solve a clean 9×9 number grid with instant conflict feedback and a calm, touch-friendly interface.
instructions: Select an empty cell and enter 1–9 so each row, column and 3×3 box contains every digit once.

title: Cascade Solitaire
description: Arrange descending same-suit runs across cascading card lanes and clear complete king-to-ace sequences.
instructions: Move exposed cards onto the next higher card of the same suit. Complete a King-to-Ace run to clear it.

title: Maze Muncher
description: Sweep a neon maze for every spark while roaming sentinels pressure your route choices and timing.
instructions: Use arrow keys, WASD or swipe to move through the maze, collect all sparks and avoid sentinels.

title: Grid Three
description: Claim a three-cell line before the computer in a fast, minimalist 3×3 strategy duel.
instructions: Choose an empty square. Make a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line of three before the computer.

title: Fusion 4096
description: Slide matching number tiles together, chain merges and push the board toward the 4096 tile.
instructions: Swipe or use arrow keys to slide all tiles. Equal values merge once per move; keep space open as values grow.

title: Open Cell Cards
description: Use four open holding cells to reorganize eight card lanes and build four suit foundations from Ace upward.
instructions: Move exposed cards between tableau lanes, four holding cells and suit foundations. Build tableau runs downward in alternating colors.

title: Neon Stack
description: Rotate and place falling polyomino blocks to complete rows before the stack reaches the ceiling.
instructions: Move and rotate falling pieces, complete full horizontal rows and keep the stack below the top edge.

title: Fossil Sprint
description: Sprint across a prehistoric skyline, jump stone obstacles and chase a longer survival distance each run.
instructions: Tap, click or press Space to jump. Clear obstacles as the scrolling speed increases.

title: Void Runner
description: Shift across suspended lanes in a glowing void and survive an accelerating sequence of gaps and barriers.
instructions: Move left or right between lanes and avoid incoming barriers for as long as possible.

title: Gravity Slope
description: Steer a rolling energy sphere down a fast neon slope, threading between gates and broken track sections.
instructions: Steer left and right with pointer, touch or keyboard controls. Stay on the track and avoid barriers.

title: Crown Draughts
description: Capture opposing pieces on an 8×8 board, force jumps and crown pieces that reach the far edge.
instructions: Select one of your pieces, then choose a highlighted diagonal move or capture. Reach the opposite edge to crown it.

title: Heart Trick
description: Play thirteen card tricks against three computer opponents while avoiding penalty hearts and the high-penalty queen.
instructions: Follow the led suit when possible. Lowest penalty score after thirteen tricks wins the hand.

title: Star Spades
description: Win card tricks with careful suit management while the star suit acts as a permanent trump suit.
instructions: Follow the led suit when possible. Star-suit cards trump other suits; win more tricks than the computer players.

title: Word Hunt Grid
description: Find hidden words across a compact letter grid by tracing straight horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines.
instructions: Drag across letters in a straight line to select each hidden word from the list.

title: Dice Five
description: Roll five dice up to three times per round, hold useful values and score combinations across thirteen rounds.
instructions: Roll up to three times, tap dice to hold them, then choose one unused scoring category for the round.

title: Neon Drift
description: Slide a lightweight car around a compact neon circuit, linking controlled drifts for a higher score.
instructions: Steer with keyboard or touch controls, carry speed through corners and maintain slides to build drift score.

title: Orb Shooter
description: Aim colored orbs into matching clusters, clear groups of three or more and keep the field above the danger line.
instructions: Aim with pointer or touch and fire an orb into the field. Match three or more of the same color to clear them.
